- [ ] Coverage is still 100% - the suite fails below it
- [ ] No `# type: ignore` and no `# noqa` were added
- [ ] Documentation updated, if this changes what somebody would read
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated, if this changes anything for a user
